topic: Gate pin-based access on the tool guard
detail: SP-011 and SP-025 must not grant memory reads by a pin's space until SP-041 stops a session from starting a harness outside its tree, or until there is stronger evidence of a real top-level harness (kernel executable path, session and tty checks). Today one command can start a fake 'claude' under a kept-alive shell and pin it in another directory (accepted risk, D-26).
note: Settled by the user on 2026-11-10: SP-025 depends on SP-041; see D-38 and SP-025.1.a6.
